# Libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(FLCore)

library(ggforce)
library(sf)

library(gridExtra)

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 16))
```

# Data preparation

We read the whole time series available (not only data from 1987 used for the model fit). 


```{r}

# ui: yearly from 1948 to 2021

ui <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="UI")

ui <- ui %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO) %>% 
  mutate(month=1, date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>%  
  select(year, date, UI)


# turb: monthly from 1948/01 to 2021/12

turb <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="TURB")

turb <- turb %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO, month=MES) %>% 
  mutate(date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>% 
  select(year, month, quarter, semester, date, TURB)

# compute turbulence per year

turb <- turb %>%
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(TURB.mean=mean(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.min=min(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.max=max(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.sd=sqrt(var(TURB, na.rm=T)),
            TURB.q1=mean(TURB[quarter==1], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q2=mean(TURB[quarter==2], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q3=mean(TURB[quarter==3], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q4=mean(TURB[quarter==4], na.rm=T),
            TURB.s1=mean(TURB[semester==1], na.rm=T),
            TURB.s2=mean(TURB[semester==2], na.rm=T)) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

# merge two datasets (ui and turb)

df <- merge(ui, turb, by=c("year"))
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(logUI=log(UI),
         logTURB.q3=log(TURB.q3))
names(df)
range(df$year)

# number of simulations

nit <- 10000

```
# Upwelling index

Fit "best" model (see file `6_surrogate_env.html.html`:

```{r}

# linear model

m.lm <- lm(logUI ~ year, data=df)
summary(m.lm)

# best p

p <- 18

# initial model
mod0 <- lm(logUI ~ sin(2*pi*year/p) + cos(2*pi*year/p) + year, data=df) 
summary(mod0)

# remove non-significant term
mod <- lm(logUI ~ sin(2*pi*year/p) + year, data=df) 
summary(mod)

plot(df$year, df$logUI, xlab="", ylab="log(UI)", type="o")
lines(df$year, predict(mod0), col=2)
lines(df$year, predict(mod), col=3)

plot(resid(mod), xlab="", ylab="Residuals")
abline(h=0)

```

Prediction (1 and 1000 iterations)

```{r}
set.seed(333) # set the seed

# one random realisation

pred.ui <- data.frame(year=2022:2099)
pred.ui$UI <- rlnorm(nrow(pred.ui),
                     predict(mod, newdata=pred.ui), 
                     sd=0.05)

plot(df$year, log(df$UI), type="o", col=1, pch=19, xlim=c(1948,2099), xlab="", ylab="logUI", ylim=range(c(log(df$UI), log(pred.ui$UI)), na.rm=T))
lines(pred.ui$year, log(pred.ui$UI), type="o", pch=19, col=2)

plot(df$year, df$UI, type="o", col=1, pch=19, xlim=c(1948,2099), xlab="", ylab="UI", ylim=c(0, max(df$UI, pred.ui$UI)))
lines(pred.ui$year, pred.ui$UI, type="o", pch=19, col=2)

# 1000 random realisations

tmp <- sapply(1:nit, function(x) 
  rlnorm(nrow(pred.ui), predict(mod, newdata=pred.ui), sd=0.05))

# transform to FLQuant
pred.ui.quant <- as.FLQuant(tmp, dim=c(1, nrow(pred.ui),1,1,1,nit))
dimnames(pred.ui.quant)$year <- pred.ui$year
# plot(pred.ui.quant)

as.data.frame(pred.ui.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()

# NO CLIMATE CHANGE SCENARIO
# 1000 random realisations

tmp <- sapply(1:nit, function(x) 
  rlnorm(nrow(pred.ui), 
         predict(mod, newdata=pred.ui)-predict(mod, newdata=pred.ui, type="terms")[,"year"]+
           c(predict(mod, newdata=data.frame(year=2022), type="terms")[,"year"]), # adjustment to scale to 2022 level,
         sd=0.05))


# transform to FLQuant
pred.ui.nocc.quant <- as.FLQuant(tmp, dim=c(1, nrow(pred.ui),1,1,1,nit))
dimnames(pred.ui.nocc.quant)$year <- pred.ui$year
# plot(pred.ui.nocc.quant)

as.data.frame(pred.ui.nocc.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()


```

# Turbulence

Fit "best" model (see file `6_surrogate_env.html.html`:

```{r}
p <- 37

# initial model

mod0 <- lm(logTURB.q3 ~ sin(2*pi*year/p) + cos(2*pi*year/p) + year, data=df) 
summary(mod0)

# remove non-significant term
mod <- lm(logTURB.q3 ~ cos(2*pi*year/p) + year, data=df) 
summary(mod)

plot(df$year, df$logTURB.q3, xlab="", ylab="log(TURB.q3)", type="o")
lines(df$year, predict(mod0), col=2)
lines(df$year, predict(mod), col=3)

plot(resid(mod), xlab="", ylab="Residuals")
abline(h=0)

```

Prediction

```{r}
set.seed(555) # set the seed

# one random realisation

pred.turb <- data.frame(year=2022:2099)
pred.turb$TURB.q3 <- rlnorm(nrow(pred.turb),
                     predict(mod, newdata=pred.turb), 
                     sd=0.05)

plot(df$year, log(df$TURB.q3), type="o", col=1, pch=19, xlim=c(1948,2099), xlab="", ylab="log turb", ylim=range(c(log(df$TURB.q3), log(pred.turb$TURB.q3)), na.rm=T))
lines(pred.turb$year, log(pred.turb$TURB.q3), type="o", pch=19, col=2)

plot(df$year, df$TURB.q3, type="o", col=1, pch=19, xlim=c(1948,2099), xlab="", ylab="turb", ylim=c(0, max(df$TURB.q3, pred.turb$TURB.q3)))
lines(pred.turb$year, pred.turb$TURB.q3, type="o", pch=19, col=2)

# 1000 random realisations

tmp <- sapply(1:nit, function(x) rlnorm(nrow(pred.turb), predict(mod, newdata=pred.turb), sd=0.05))
# dim(tmp)

# transform to FLQuant
pred.turb.quant <- as.FLQuant(tmp, dim=c(1, nrow(pred.turb),1,1,1,nit))
dimnames(pred.turb.quant)$year <- pred.turb$year
# plot(pred.turb.quant)

as.data.frame(pred.turb.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()

# NO CLIMATE CHANGE SCENARIO
# 1000 random realisations

tmp <- sapply(1:nit, function(x) 
  rlnorm(nrow(pred.turb), 
         predict(mod, newdata=pred.turb)-predict(mod, newdata=pred.turb, type="terms")[,"year"]+
           c(predict(mod, newdata=data.frame(year=2022), type="terms")[,"year"]), # adjustment to scale to 2022 level,
         sd=0.05))

# transform to FLQuant
pred.turb.nocc.quant <- as.FLQuant(tmp, dim=c(1, nrow(pred.turb),1,1,1,nit))
dimnames(pred.turb.nocc.quant)$year <- pred.turb$year
# plot(pred.turb.nocc.quant)

as.data.frame(pred.turb.nocc.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()

```

# Check the joint distribution 

With CC: 

```{r}

points.sf <- st_as_sf(subset(df, select=c("UI","TURB.q3"), year %in% c(1987:2021)), coords=c("UI","TURB.q3"))

hull0 <- st_convex_hull(st_union(points.sf)) # without buffer
hull <- st_buffer(hull0, dist=50) # with buffer
hull <- as.data.frame(st_coordinates(hull)[,1:2]) # extract coordinates
names(hull) <- c("UI","TURB.q3") # change names
hull.sf <- sfheaders::sf_polygon(obj = hull)

test <- data.frame(UI=c(pred.ui.quant), TURB.q3=c(pred.turb.quant))
test.sf <- st_as_sf(test, coords=c("UI","TURB.q3"))
test$sel <- st_within(test.sf, hull.sf, sparse=F)

ggplot(test, aes(UI, TURB.q3, col=sel))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.3)+
  geom_point(data=subset(df, select=c("UI","TURB.q3"), year %in% c(1987:2021)), aes(x=UI, y=TURB.q3), pch=19, col=1, inherit.aes = F)+
  geom_polygon(data=hull, aes(UI, TURB.q3), col=1, fill=NA, inherit.aes=F)

# are there enough samples to reach 1000 iterations?

cbind(as.data.frame(pred.ui.quant), test) %>% 
  subset(sel) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(n=dplyr::n())

# subsample

tmp <- cbind(as.data.frame(pred.ui.quant), test) %>% 
  subset(sel) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  slice_sample(n=1000, replace=F)%>% 
  mutate(it.new=1:dplyr::n()) %>% 
  arrange(it.new, year)

dim(tmp)
table(tmp$year)

cbind(tmp) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(n=dplyr::n()) 

p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(UI, TURB.q3, col=sel))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.3)+
  geom_point(data=subset(df, select=c("UI","TURB.q3"), year %in% c(1987:2021)), aes(x=UI, y=TURB.q3), pch=19, col=1, inherit.aes = F)+
  geom_polygon(data=hull, aes(UI, TURB.q3), col=1, fill=NA, inherit.aes=F)
p

as.data.frame(tmp) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, UI, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()

as.data.frame(tmp) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, TURB.q3, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()

# transform to FLQuants
pred.ui.bound.quant <- as.FLQuant(tmp$UI, dim=c(1, nrow(pred.ui),1,1,1,1000))
dimnames(pred.ui.bound.quant)$year <- pred.ui$year

pred.turb.bound.quant <- as.FLQuant(tmp$TURB.q3, dim=c(1, nrow(pred.turb),1,1,1,1000))
dimnames(pred.turb.bound.quant)$year <- pred.turb$year

```

# comparison

```{r}
p1 <- as.data.frame(pred.ui.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()
p2 <- as.data.frame(pred.ui.bound.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()
grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)

p1 <- as.data.frame(pred.ui.nocc.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()
p2 <- as.data.frame(pred.ui.bound.nocc.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()
grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)

p1 <- as.data.frame(pred.turb.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()
p2 <- as.data.frame(pred.turb.bound.quant) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()
grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)

  geom_boxplot()

  ggplot(aes(year, data, group=year))+
  geom_boxplot()
grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol=2)

```

saveRDS(iter(pred.ui.quant, 1:1000), file="results/ui_projection_1000it_reduced.RDS")
